# agent-budget-guard

> Framework-neutral budget guard for agent runs: caps on steps, tokens, tool calls per tool and elapsed time with an injected clock, nested sub-budgets and terminal exceeded state Python package `trysac-agent-budget-guard`, import name `agent_budget_guard`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
